rootCause: Every spawnSync on the /api/revise path ran without a timeout, and callChatModel used a bare fetch with no abort signal. Node's HTTP server is single-threaded, so one stuck child (proved with a blocking git post-checkout hook during `git worktree add`) froze the whole server and the POST never settled.

verification.name: before — blocked git worktree add (unfixed server :8787)
verification.command: curl -sS -m 60 -X POST /api/revise (jobId 024-job-3l9xtu) with blocking post-checkout hook
verification.result: no response until the blocked child was killed externally; GET /api/health timed out with 0 bytes 3x in a row; request finally ended HTTP 400 at 32.7s only because of outside intervention

verification.name: after — blocked git worktree add (fixed server :8799)
verification.result: HTTP 504 at 60.06s, error names the command and the 60s budget; no outside intervention needed

verification.name: after — revise that recreates a removed worktree
verification.result: HTTP 200 in 2.18s; recreated=true; job enqueued into the new worktree's jobs/ dir

notes: spawnSync still blocks the event loop while it runs; the fix bounds that window and guarantees the endpoint answers. Moving the pipeline off the HTTP thread is out of scope.
